properties.name: Resolve
properties.description:
Resolve enables B2B companies to boost sales and cash flow by offering their buyers 30, 60, or 90 day payment terms, while ensuring the seller gets paid upfront risk-free. Our platform automates credit checks, underwriting, invoicing, and collections, helping companies improve cash flow, reduce manual accounts receivable work, and increase conversion rates.

Traditional net terms are slow and risky. Sellers often act like banks, extending credit, tracking invoices, and chasing payments. Resolve replaces that manual process with an automated, end-to-end net terms solution. From real-time credit decisions to fast invoice financing and collections, Resolve simplifies B2B payments so teams can focus on growth instead of administrative work.

Resolve integrates seamlessly with leading ecommerce and ERP platforms such as NetSuite, BigCommerce (2025 Innovative Integration Award winner), QuickBooks, and Shopify. Buyers can check out instantly using preapproved terms, and sellers receive advance payment within 24-hours on approved invoices. Resolve manages the credit risk and collections behind the scenes so sellers can offer flexible payment options without impacting their cash flow or taking on bad debt exposure.

Affirm and Resolve share their founding history in Max Levchin. Max was previously co-founder and CTO at PayPal and founded Affirm in 2012. Resolve was born in Max’s San Francisco based venture studio, HVF, by co-founders Chris Tsai and Brian Nguyen. Having both worked closely with Affirm, the pair saw an opportunity to bring the ‘buy now, pay later’ model to the B2B world. They created Resolve to modernize business payments, reimagining traditional net terms with intelligent credit technology, instant financing, and embedded finance infrastructure built for scale.

Most businesses leave significant value on the table simply because their vendors don't accept credit cards. FLOWT was built to change that.

FLOWT enables companies to pay any vendor via credit card, regardless of whether that vendor accepts one. The result is immediate and measurable: 30 to 60 days of payment float, access to credit card rewards and incentives on large transactions, and greater leverage in supplier negotiations.

FLOWT specializes in high-value B2B payments, processing transactions up to $1 million per swipe.

The company was founded out of a real operational challenge. FLOWT's co-founder was managing over $20 million annually in supplier costs for his Airport Concession business and needed a smarter way to handle cash flow, capture card rewards at scale, build business credit, and access early pay discounts. All tools that were effectively out of reach because his vendors didn't accept credit cards. No solution existed at the time, so he built one.

That solution is FLOWT. The company exists to give businesses the financial flexibility and working capital advantages that credit cards were always meant to provide, at the scale modern enterprises actually operate.

properties.name: Heron | Enterprise Payments, Powered by Stablecoin
properties.description:
Stablecoin rails are here. Enterprise orchestration is missing. Heron solves that.

Heron is the enterprise orchestration layer for stablecoin-enabled cross-border payments. We help enterprises make international payments feel like domestic transfers by abstracting stablecoin rails behind the scenes and orchestrating execution across the broadest global payment coverage.

In the Heron model, enterprises stay fully fiat-facing. The sender pays in fiat, Heron uses stablecoin infrastructure for the international transfer layer, and the recipient receives fiat through local payment rails. This fiat to stablecoin to fiat model gives companies the benefits of stablecoin rails without requiring them to touch wallets, custody, or crypto workflows.

Heron’s differentiation is twofold. First, we aggregate the fragmented ecosystem of stablecoin gateways, liquidity providers, and payout partners into one enterprise platform, giving customers unmatched global coverage. Second, we orchestrate every payment through intelligent control agents that assist in determining the best route based on cost, speed, resilience, liquidity, and policy.

These agents monitor execution, handle exceptions, and adapt routing in response to disruptions, while transfers themselves execute deterministically.
Integrated into treasury and finance systems, Heron creates a new operating model for cross-border finance: making global payments feel local.

properties.name: Rhofin
properties.description:
Rhofin — Making Supply Chains Liquid

Rhofin is a US-based cargo finance platform that embeds working capital directly into logistics platforms — so shippers can access financing at the point of shipment, not weeks later.
We partner with freight forwarders, NVOCCs, and 3PLs to offer their shipper clients a faster path to cash. When a shipment is verified, a financing decision can be ready in hours. No bank meetings. No paperwork. No waiting 60–90 days for a buyer to pay.
How it works
Rhofin purchases trade receivables from suppliers under the BAFT 2022 Master Receivables Purchase Agreement (MRPA). Financing is structured to be non-recourse — buyer credit risk sits with our institutional funder, not with the supplier. Each transaction is supported by a Notice of Assignment (NOA) and where applicable UCC-1 and UCC Article 12 filings.
For logistics partners — freight forwarders, NVOCCs, 3PLs
Integrate once via REST API. Your shipment data becomes the underwriting signal. Your customers get working capital. You earn a referral fee on every transaction, with no capital on your balance sheet.
Anchor partnership
Allcargo Global — one of the world's largest NVOCC and LCL logistics operators — is Rhofin's anchor 3PL partner for the US market.
Pilot launching Q2 2026 — founding shipper and logistics partner applications now open.

As an early mover with experienced leadership, Duplo is positioned to deliver the tools businesses need to thrive in today’s interconnected world. With Duplo, businesses can take control of their financial operations and payments, eliminate errors and inefficiencies, and unlock new opportunities for growth.

entity.name: Resolve
entity.description:
Resolve enables B2B companies to boost sales and cash flow by offering their buyers 30, 60, or 90 day payment terms, while ensuring the seller gets paid upfront risk-free. Our platform automates credit checks, underwriting, invoicing, and collections, helping companies improve cash flow, reduce manual accounts receivable work, and increase conversion rates.

Traditional net terms are slow and risky. Sellers often act like banks, extending credit, tracking invoices, and chasing payments. Resolve replaces that manual process with an automated, end-to-end net terms solution. From real-time credit decisions to fast invoice financing and collections, Resolve simplifies B2B payments so teams can focus on growth instead of administrative work.

Resolve integrates seamlessly with leading ecommerce and ERP platforms such as NetSuite, BigCommerce (2025 Innovative Integration Award winner), QuickBooks, and Shopify. Buyers can check out instantly using preapproved terms, and sellers receive advance payment within 24-hours on approved invoices. Resolve manages the credit risk and collections behind the scenes so sellers can offer flexible payment options without impacting their cash flow or taking on bad debt exposure.

Affirm and Resolve share their founding history in Max Levchin. Max was previously co-founder and CTO at PayPal and founded Affirm in 2012. Resolve was born in Max’s San Francisco based venture studio, HVF, by co-founders Chris Tsai and Brian Nguyen. Having both worked closely with Affirm, the pair saw an opportunity to bring the ‘buy now, pay later’ model to the B2B world. They created Resolve to modernize business payments, reimagining traditional net terms with intelligent credit technology, instant financing, and embedded finance infrastructure built for scale.

entity.description:
Most businesses leave significant value on the table simply because their vendors don't accept credit cards. FLOWT was built to change that.

FLOWT enables companies to pay any vendor via credit card, regardless of whether that vendor accepts one. The result is immediate and measurable: 30 to 60 days of payment float, access to credit card rewards and incentives on large transactions, and greater leverage in supplier negotiations.

FLOWT specializes in high-value B2B payments, processing transactions up to $1 million per swipe.

The company was founded out of a real operational challenge. FLOWT's co-founder was managing over $20 million annually in supplier costs for his Airport Concession business and needed a smarter way to handle cash flow, capture card rewards at scale, build business credit, and access early pay discounts. All tools that were effectively out of reach because his vendors didn't accept credit cards. No solution existed at the time, so he built one.

That solution is FLOWT. The company exists to give businesses the financial flexibility and working capital advantages that credit cards were always meant to provide, at the scale modern enterprises actually operate.

entity.name: Heron | Enterprise Payments, Powered by Stablecoin
entity.description:
Stablecoin rails are here. Enterprise orchestration is missing. Heron solves that.

Heron is the enterprise orchestration layer for stablecoin-enabled cross-border payments. We help enterprises make international payments feel like domestic transfers by abstracting stablecoin rails behind the scenes and orchestrating execution across the broadest global payment coverage.

In the Heron model, enterprises stay fully fiat-facing. The sender pays in fiat, Heron uses stablecoin infrastructure for the international transfer layer, and the recipient receives fiat through local payment rails. This fiat to stablecoin to fiat model gives companies the benefits of stablecoin rails without requiring them to touch wallets, custody, or crypto workflows.

Heron’s differentiation is twofold. First, we aggregate the fragmented ecosystem of stablecoin gateways, liquidity providers, and payout partners into one enterprise platform, giving customers unmatched global coverage. Second, we orchestrate every payment through intelligent control agents that assist in determining the best route based on cost, speed, resilience, liquidity, and policy.

These agents monitor execution, handle exceptions, and adapt routing in response to disruptions, while transfers themselves execute deterministically.
Integrated into treasury and finance systems, Heron creates a new operating model for cross-border finance: making global payments feel local.

entity.name: Rhofin
entity.description:
Rhofin — Making Supply Chains Liquid

Rhofin is a US-based cargo finance platform that embeds working capital directly into logistics platforms — so shippers can access financing at the point of shipment, not weeks later.
We partner with freight forwarders, NVOCCs, and 3PLs to offer their shipper clients a faster path to cash. When a shipment is verified, a financing decision can be ready in hours. No bank meetings. No paperwork. No waiting 60–90 days for a buyer to pay.
How it works
Rhofin purchases trade receivables from suppliers under the BAFT 2022 Master Receivables Purchase Agreement (MRPA). Financing is structured to be non-recourse — buyer credit risk sits with our institutional funder, not with the supplier. Each transaction is supported by a Notice of Assignment (NOA) and where applicable UCC-1 and UCC Article 12 filings.
For logistics partners — freight forwarders, NVOCCs, 3PLs
Integrate once via REST API. Your shipment data becomes the underwriting signal. Your customers get working capital. You earn a referral fee on every transaction, with no capital on your balance sheet.
Anchor partnership
Allcargo Global — one of the world's largest NVOCC and LCL logistics operators — is Rhofin's anchor 3PL partner for the US market.
Pilot launching Q2 2026 — founding shipper and logistics partner applications now open.

entity.name: Duplo
entity.description:
Duplo helps businesses seamlessly navigate the complexities of local and international payments, expense management, and foreign exchange. Rooted in Africa but built for global commerce, Duplo empowers businesses to streamline financial operations and thrive in today's fast-paced, interconnected economy, grow their global footprint, and capitalize on the growth of emerging markets.

Our platform offers a comprehensive, end-to-end solution for businesses to better manage their financial operations and local and international payments. Our expense management tools enable finance teams to easily handle approvals, manage reimbursements, submit receipts, calculate taxes, and generate accurate reports—enabling businesses to automate their workflows and reduce errors. 

We also offer multi-currency wallets, allowing businesses to negotiate, exchange, and send multiple currencies in one place, making international transactions and cross-border trade between Africa, Asia, and other regions more efficient. 

Our AI-powered platform brings a new level of fraud detection to spend management, flagging unusual expenses and ensuring consistency. Additionally, our direct debit functionality allows businesses to manage payments directly from their bank accounts or their existing ERP solutions, creating a seamless payment experience.

What sets Duplo apart is our comprehensive end-to-end finance operations and payments platform, creating a two-sided network that connects buyers and suppliers. Backed by licenses such as PSSP, FINTRAC, FINCEN 2025, and IMTO, Duplo ensures secure and compliant transactions across countries. 

As an early mover with experienced leadership, Duplo is positioned to deliver the tools businesses need to thrive in today’s interconnected world. With Duplo, businesses can take control of their financial operations and payments, eliminate errors and inefficiencies, and unlock new opportunities for growth.
